mapper.update: INSERT INTO patent (merge_key, patent_type, registration_number, application_date, title, url) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{patentType}, #{registrationNumber}, #{applicationDate}, #{title}, #{url}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO company_patent (company_id, patent_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{patentId}, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid) ON CONFLICT (company_id, patent_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_patent SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE deleted = false AND company_id = #{companyId}
UPDATE company_patent SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE deleted = false AND company_id = #{companyId} AND sync_id != #{syncId}::uuid
